<p class="uni-intro">New York's oldest Catholic and Jesuit university — and the source of our dynamic-array list lab.</p>

> 纽约最古老的天主教耶稣会大学——我们的动态数组线性表实验就来自这里。

## Why it matters <span class='zh-inline'>(为何重要)</span>

Fordham's Jesuit tradition pairs a broad education with a serious cybersecurity and data-science programme.

> 耶稣会的博雅传统与扎实的网络安全、数据科学项目在福特汉姆并存。

## Background <span class='zh-inline'>(背景)</span>

Founded in 1841 as St John's College by Bishop John Hughes, Fordham is the oldest Catholic and Jesuit university in the northeastern US, with campuses at Rose Hill and Lincoln Center.

> 1841 年由 John Hughes 主教以“圣约翰学院”之名创办，是美国东北部最古老的天主教耶稣会大学，拥有 Rose Hill 与 Lincoln Center 两个校区。
